info.title: Rumi Notification Service API
info.description: REST API of the Alerts & Notification bounded context: alerts raised by seismic risk (US14, US16) or by sensor readings that exceed a threshold (US15), and the thresholds of each sensor.

tags.name: Thresholds
tags.description: Alert limits of each sensor; only administrators reach them through the gateway

tags.name: Simulations (dev only)
tags.description: Raise alerts by hand while the messaging listeners are not running

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Alerts raised by seismic risk or by sensor readings that exceed a threshold

put.summary: Configure the threshold of a sensor
put.description: Creates the threshold of the sensor or changes its limits (US15). A reading at or above the warning value raises a HIGH alert; at or above the critical value, a CRITICAL alert. The warning value must be lower than the critical value.

requestBody.description: Building of the sensor and its limits

post.summary: Simulate a risk index of Seismic Correlation
post.description: Calls createAlertFromRisk, the method the RabbitMQ listener of the risk event calls. Sending the same riskIndexId twice returns the same alert.

201.description: Alert raised (or the alert already raised for that risk index)

value.title: Anomalía estructural crítica tras un sismo
value.message: Anomalía estructural crítica detectada tras un sismo. Fuente: reporte del IGP (evento 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-b2c1-0a9f8e7d6c5b) y sensores del edificio. Detectado: 30/10/2026 09:32 (hora de Lima). Siga el plan de evacuación de su edificio y las indicaciones de las autoridades. Rumi complementa al SASPe; no es una alerta oficial.

post.description: Compares the reading with the threshold of the sensor (US15). Answers 201 with the alert when the threshold is exceeded, and 204 when no alert is raised.

get.summary: List the alerts of a building
get.description: Returns the alerts of the building, newest first (US14, US15, US16). Filter by status to get, for example, only the OPEN alerts. Only an ADMINISTRATOR or a RESIDENT of the building, as stated in their token, can list them.

buildingId.description: Building where the sensor is installed

warningValue.description: A reading at or above this value raises a HIGH alert

criticalValue.description: A reading at or above this value raises a CRITICAL alert; it must be greater than the warning value

ThresholdResponse.description: Alert limits configured for a sensor

buildingId.description: Building where the sensor is installed

warningValue.description: A reading at or above this value raises a HIGH alert

criticalValue.description: A reading at or above this value raises a CRITICAL alert

RiskSimulationRequest.description: Risk index to simulate, as Seismic Correlation would publish it (dev profile only)

riskIndexId.description: Risk index id; a new one is generated when omitted

seismicEventId.description: Seismic event id; a new one is generated when omitted

type.description: SEISMIC_RISK when raised by a risk index, THRESHOLD_EXCEEDED when raised by a reading

title.description: Short title of the alert, in Spanish
title.example: Anomalía estructural crítica tras un sismo

message.description: Message for the residents, in Spanish: the anomaly, its source, when it was detected and a reference to the building's plan and the authorities. It never orders an evacuation
message.example: Anomalía estructural crítica detectada tras un sismo. Fuente: reporte del IGP (evento 9e8d7c6b-5a4f-4e3d-b2c1-0a9f8e7d6c5b) y sensores del edificio. Detectado: 30/10/2026 09:32 (hora de Lima). Siga el plan de evacuación de su edificio y las indicaciones de las autoridades. Rumi complementa al SASPe; no es una alerta oficial.

evacuationRequired.description: True for a CRITICAL seismic risk (US16): the app shows the building's evacuation plan prominently. Rumi never orders an evacuation; the residents follow the building's plan and the authorities

riskIndexId.description: Risk index of Seismic Correlation that raised the alert; null for threshold alerts

seismicEventId.description: Seismic event reported by the IGP; null for threshold alerts

sensorId.description: Sensor whose reading raised the alert; null for seismic risk alerts

zone.description: Zone of the sensor; null for seismic risk alerts

measuredValue.description: Reading that exceeded the threshold; null for seismic risk alerts

occurredAt.description: When the risk was calculated or the reading was recorded (UTC)

ReadingSimulationRequest.description: Sensor reading to compare with its threshold, as Structural Monitoring would publish it (dev profile only)
